summary: Tested Jan-2026 feature batch: admin image upload (Emergent object storage), public /api/files serving, Banner Studio CRUD, homepage hero wiring to /api/banners, admin nav link, and order-status email regression (console fallback). Backend: 7/7 new pytest cases pass (upload + banners) plus existing regression (admin_orders_list_and_flow) still green. Frontend: full end-to-end Playwright flows pass — admin login, /admin/banners CRUD with image upload thumbnail + save, hero displays active banners with rotation dots (hero-dot-0, hero-shop-now with CTA text/link from banner), /admin/products Add Product opens modal with ImageUploader, upload works (thumbnail appears, 'image(s) uploaded' toast), Save creates product ('Product saved' toast, product visible in list). admin-nav-banners link present. Email console fallback confirmed in supervisor logs ([EMAIL:console] to=... subject='Your order is being prepared/shipped ...' — RESEND_API_KEY not set), which is expected per request.

issues: When an active banner is selected, subtitle is always taken from banner but the accent-styled second-line is dropped (heading.accent forced empty). Result is a single pink line — visually consistent but loses the two-line accent that the default hero shows. Consider parsing/splitting banner title or keeping DEFAULT.accent styling.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: preserve two-line hero styling when a banner is active (see design note).
Optional: In AdminBanners.jsx, `In` component only wires data-testid on the Title field; adding testids for subtitle/cta/link would make future automation less brittle.
critical_code_review_comments: upload_routes.py serve_file: uses record.content_type when present, else falls back to storage-returned content-type — good. If DB record is missing but storage has file, the response media_type is 'application/octet-stream' fallback rather than image/*. Consider inferring from extension. Non-blocking.
Hero3D.jsx: when active banner exists, `heading.accent` is hardcoded to empty and title renders single-color — intentional but drops the two-line default look. Minor UX regression on hero styling.

AdminBanners.jsx: order defaults to 0 and multiple banners with same order share same slot; sort by (order asc) but no secondary tiebreaker (e.g., created_at). Rotation still works but ordering can be non-deterministic.
Storage init: put/get_object re-inits key on 404; good self-heal. However both endpoints use module-global `_storage_key` without lock — under high concurrency two workers may init twice (harmless).
mailer.send_order_email: swallows all exceptions from Resend and logs; good for reliability. Ensure a metric/alert in production when RESEND_API_KEY is set.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted 1 test banner (TEST_PW_Banner_Zzz) via UI. Created 1 test product (TEST PW Product <ts>) via UI Add Product with uploaded image; delete triggered via trash icon (browser confirm auto-accepted, though verify in DB if leftover). Uploaded 2 small 1x1 PNGs to object storage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature batch is stable. Backend pytest suite for uploads+banners lives in /app/backend/tests/test_banners_upload.py — reuse. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported when invoking pytest locally (frontend .env is not auto-loaded). Emails intentionally log to console (RESEND_API_KEY empty). Razorpay stays in MOCK mode. Only cosmetic action item is hero styling loss when banner is active.
rca of the issue: No blocking issue identified. All 6 requested items verified working end-to-end.
